caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil and depicts a technical illustration of a wall-mounted candle holder with a circular, concave reflector. The composition includes three main views of the object: a top-down view, a side profile, and a three-quarter perspective view. The reflector is a large, shallow dish divided into a grid pattern with concentric rings and radial lines, attached to a cylindrical column that holds a single upright candle. The candle is elongated and white, positioned in a vertical holder that emerges from the base and extends in front of the reflector. The side profile view shows the reflector mounted on a vertical support that attaches to the wall. There is also a scale with inch markings situated above the perspective view, indicating dimensions for reference. The illustration is monochromatic, utilizing varying shades of gray for shading, dimension, and detail, and is signed by the artist “J. Stalope” in the lower right-hand corner. The entire layout is neatly contained within a rectangular border.
title: Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
